subject: Dumb Info Ops Ramp Up Against Reasonable Colorado Measures To Protect Children
posts:
Defending child protection ballot measures or weaponizing culture war narratives? Colorado's 2026 propositions spark partisan media firestorms.
Evidence: Ballot initiatives, Media framing, Public polling
#Aletheia #Colorado #USPol

The article argues that legacy media runs dishonest information ops and outrageous caricatures to paint supporters of Colorado child protection measures as extremists.
Stated Judgement: (+1.00, +0.00) — Lesser Good

While the ballot measures address genuine policy concerns like human trafficking and sports fairness, partisan commentary often reduces complex civic debates to tribal culture-war signaling.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.70, -0.60) — Greater Evil

Verdict: FAIL — Awakening into Destruction.
The article correctly identifies partisan media bias but frames civic disagreement as pure bad-faith malice to rally partisan alignment.

Integrity: Partially Distorted (Hypocrisy: 3.2, z: 2)
Voters across Colorado are weighing three initiatives in November 2026: Prop 133 on child trafficking penalties, Prop 134 on sports eligibility, and Prop 135 on minor surgical restrictions.

The Bright Side:
Highlighting the actual text of ballot measures encourages voters to bypass media spin and examine policy details directly.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
The analysis confuses WHO is speaking (partisan outlets vs voters) with WHAT the policy text says, substituting editorial grievance for empirical debate.

Social Physics Analysis:
The commentary runs a Smart Selfish Maneuver, taking a popular policy stance and weaponizing it to cast all opposition as morally corrupt, maintaining perpetual cultural conflict.

The Trajectory: The Path of Awakening into Destruction.
Modal Dynamics: will be -> is not via Red Top (The Imperial Trap).
Promising protective certainty while erecting barriers of partisan division.

The Unavoidable Truth: Ballot initiatives deserve sober evaluation based on their statutory text rather than caricatures.

The Unavoidable Lie: Disagreement on complex social policy is proof of absolute moral depravity.

Alethekanon:
Partisan commentary frames normal policy disputes as existential warfare, substituting outrage for constructive civic deliberation.

Awwthekanon:
When every public debate turns into a battleground of labels, families caught in the crossfire lose the steady support they truly need.

Brothekanon:
Everyone's shouting past each other instead of just reading the actual ballot text and talking like normal human beings.

Spirithekanon:
"Let your speech always be gracious, seasoned with salt" Colossians 4:6 PASS
Harsh rhetoric clouds wisdom and obscures the path to true justice.

Stated Claim / Post Context:
Dumb Info Ops Ramp Up Against Reasonable Colorado Measures To Protect Children

Sharing a belief with 80 percent of the population makes you a dangerous extremist — according to the legacy media.

Actual Article Body:
Sharing a belief with 80 percent of the population makes you a dangerous extremist — according to the legacy media.

Editor’s note: This article discusses mature themes.

Distraction, deflection, misdirection. Don’t read the “news” to figure out how to vote.

In Colorado this year, Proposition 134 would limit participation in school sports on the basis of sex: boys on teams for boys, girls on teams for girls. You can read the unremarkable language of the ballot measure on the website of the Colorado Secretary of State. If passed, it would have the effect of “restricting participation in all K-12 and collegiate school sports based on the participant’s sex as determined by certain aspects of their biological reproductive system.”

You probably don’t need help understanding those biological reproductive systems, some portion of which you can identify in the shower. We all know the difference between boys and girls, a distinction that human beings have not typically struggled to figure out.

So here’s how opponents of the measure characterize it:

This conversation right here is why the risk of invasive genital inspection is very real. The measure opens the door to these invasive inspections that will be done by adults on children.  Vote No on Prop 134.

Prop 134 is the “invasive genital inspection” measure. It’s not even a clever lie.

1.) Boys should play sports on teams for boys

2.) OH NO WHY ARE YOU SAYING THAT STRANGERS SHOULD MAKE LITTLE CHILDREN TAKE OFF THEIR CLOTHES SO STRANGERS CAN SEE THEIR GENITALS!?!?!?

News headline from the pro-trans Advocate:

Not just genital exams, forced genital exams. You sign up for football and pretty soon strangers come and pin you down to rip your pants off. All those poor little kids, tied to an examination table so strangers can point between their legs.

Protect Kids Colorado, the group sponsoring Prop 134, offers a fact check on the genital inspection claim, but they shouldn’t need to. Fifty years ago, or twenty years ago, no one found the idea of boys and girls enormously hard to puzzle out, and high schools weren’t staring at everyone’s penises and vaginas to resolve the mystery. A return to the long-established reality of normal behavior is framed as a bizarre act of sexual aggression.

This is bad faith 101: An argument about a ballot measure isn’t about the question raised by the ballot measure, but instead revolves around fake panic and shameless lying.

The other maneuver in the “news” is the herding mechanism of associating a measure with an identity. The group behind Prop 134 is also backing two other measures this year, one to more severely punish people who traffic children for sexual exploitation and one to ban sex-rejecting procedures for minors. Here’s how the Colorado Times Recorder just explained the three measures:

The opening of the discussion doesn’t center on the point of the measures. Instead, it opens on identity framing. If you don’t think children should have their healthy bodies mutilated in the service of trans ideology, you’re basically handling serpents and speaking in tongues at this very moment. No other explanation will suffice. The way you vote isn’t about the actual things the ballot measures really do. The only point is about what kind of person you are. Just imagine what the other “progressive” moms in Boulder will think of you at social events!

Of course, none of the framing is real. A New York Times poll conducted in 2025 found that “just 18 percent of Americans believe transgender female athletes — those who were male at birth — should be allowed to compete in women’s sports. Nearly 80 percent say they should not.” The point of framing a measure on sexual identity and children’s sports as a benchmark of cultural status isn’t to report on reality; rather, the point is to stigmatize and corral voters, pointing people away from what they actually believe. Sharing a belief with 80 percent of the population makes you a dangerous extremist.

These are the games the media will be playing through election day. Skip all of it. If you want to know how to vote on a ballot measure, read the ballot measure. See what it does, not what the endlessly dishonest legacy media want you to think it does.

Protect Kids Colorado offers the plain and unedited language of their three Colorado ballot measures on their website, and they also offer a list of “Colorado laws that mandate gender ideology.” Start with reality, and figure out the rest for yourself.
